import re, collections

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); cnt=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    walls=[(r,'row') for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x==2 for x in row)]
    walls += [(c,'col') for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    divider,axis=walls[0]
    points=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    objcols={grid[r][c] for r,c in points}
    # task has one non-background object color
    color=next(iter(objcols))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,c in points if grid[r][c]==color]
    rmin=min(r for r,c in pts); rmax=max(r for r,c in pts)
    cmin=min(c for r,c in pts); cmax=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis=='row':
        if rmin>divider:
            delta=-(rmin-divider-1)
        else:
            delta=divider-rmax-1
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        newpts=[(r+delta,c) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in newpts: out[r][c]=color
        nrmin=rmin+delta; nrmax=rmax+delta
        line=nrmax+1 if nrmin>divider else nrmin-1
        for c in range(w): out[line][c]=8
    else:
        if cmin>divider:
            delta=-(cmin-divider-1)
        else:
            delta=divider-cmax-1
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        newpts=[(r,c+delta) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in newpts: out[r][c]=color
        ncmin=cmin+delta; ncmax=cmax+delta
        line=ncmax+1 if ncmin>divider else ncmin-1
        for r in range(h): out[r][line]=8
    return out

def extract_grids(text):
    grids=[]
    for label in ('input','output'):
        m=re.search(rf'Demo pair \d+ {label} \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)(?=\nDemo pair|\n\nSame instance)',text,re.S)
        if not m: raise ValueError(label)
        h,w=map(int,m.group(1,2))
        rows=[]
        for line in m.group(3).strip().splitlines()[:h]:
            vals=list(map(int,line.split()))
            if len(vals)!=w: raise ValueError((label,len(vals),w,line))
            rows.append(vals)
        grids.append(rows)
    return grids
texts=[]
for e in entries:
 m=e.get('message',{})
 if m.get('role')=='user':
  content=m.get('content',[])
  txt=''.join(part.get('text','') for part in content if isinstance(part,dict) and part.get('type')=='text')
  if 'Demo pair' in txt: texts.append(txt)
print('demo texts',len(texts))
demos=[extract_grids(t) for t in texts]
for i,(inp,expected) in enumerate(demos,1):
 result=transform(inp)
 print(i, result==expected, (len(inp),len(inp[0])), next(((r,c,result[r][c],expected[r][c]) for r in range(len(inp)) for c in range(len(inp[0])) if result[r][c]!=expected[r][c]),None))

src='''import collections

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    walls = [(r, "row") for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    walls += [(c, "col") for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    divider, axis = walls[0]
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (background, 2)]
    color = grid[points[0][0]][points[0][1]]
    points = [(r, c) for r, c in points if grid[r][c] == color]
    rmin, rmax = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    cmin, cmax = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if axis == "row":
        delta = -(rmin - divider - 1) if rmin > divider else divider - rmax - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        new_points = [(r + delta, c) for r, c in points]
        for r, c in new_points:
            out[r][c] = color
        new_min, new_max = rmin + delta, rmax + delta
        line = new_max + 1 if new_min > divider else new_min - 1
        out[line] = [8] * w
    else:
        delta = -(cmin - divider - 1) if cmin > divider else divider - cmax - 1
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c] = background
        new_points = [(r, c + delta) for r, c in points]
        for r, c in new_points:
            out[r][c] = color
        new_min, new_max = cmin + delta, cmax + delta
        line = new_max + 1 if new_min > divider else new_min - 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][line] = 8
    return out
'''
